request.text: At nine tonight, ask me whether I still want a 6:30 wake-up reminder for tomorrow; don't create it unless I confirm.

responsibilities.outcome: At nine tonight, ask whether the user still wants a 6:30 wake-up reminder for tomorrow, without creating it before confirmation.

new_goals.description: At nine tonight, ask for confirmation before creating a 6:30 wake-up reminder for tomorrow.
new_goals.source_text: At nine tonight, ask me whether I still want a 6:30 wake-up reminder for tomorrow; don't create it unless I confirm.
constraints: Do not create the wake-up reminder unless the user confirms after being asked.
success_criteria: At nine tonight, the user is asked whether they still want the reminder.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The admitted request establishes one timed confirmation question; reminder creation remains conditional on a later answer.

semantic_facts: Nine o'clock authorizes asking the confirmation question; it does not supply the confirmation required to create the 6:30 reminder.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that the wake-up reminder was created or that the user confirmed merely because nine o'clock arrived.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A readiness time is incorrectly substituted for a distinct user-confirmation condition.
The Planner executes a stateful effect when re-entry authorizes only a confirmation question.
